استطردن (form X)
# اِسْتَطْرَدْنَ (istaṭradna) /is.tatˤ.rad.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَطْرَدَ (istaṭrada)
# اُسْتُطْرِدْنَ (ustuṭridna) /us.tutˤ.rid.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَطْرَدَ (istaṭrada)
# اِسْتَطْرِدْنَ (istaṭridna) /is.tatˤ.rid.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَطْرَدَ (istaṭrada)
